name: postgresql-17.9
description: Temporary list. Each statement here is one that the oracle rejects and pgtk-sql accepts. The strict check of #95 found them. The differential test expects an over-acceptance failure for each one where the oracle of the build's target version rejects it. Remove an entry when the grammar fix lands. The list must become empty.

causes.e-string-unicode-escape: An E string with an incorrect \u or \U escape: too few hex digits, a code point above U+10FFFF, or a surrogate that is not in a pair (scan.l, <xeu>, {xeunicodefail}, check_unicode_value and the surrogate pair checks; 42601 or 22025).
causes.u-string-unicode-escape: A U& string with an incorrect Unicode escape: too few hex digits, a code point above U+10FFFF, or a surrogate that is not in a pair (parser.c, str_udeescape, called from base_yylex; 42601).
causes.zero-length-identifier: A zero-length delimited identifier "" (scan.l, <xd>{xdstop}, 'zero-length delimited identifier'; 42601).
causes.within-group-order-by: An aggregate call with ORDER BY in its arguments and WITHIN GROUP (gram.y, func_expr, 'cannot use multiple ORDER BY clauses with WITHIN GROUP'; 42601).
causes.with-ties-skip-locked: FETCH ... WITH TIES with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (gram.y, insertSelectOptions, 'SKIP LOCKED and WITH TIES options cannot be used together'; 0A000).
causes.publication-current-schema: CURRENT_SCHEMA as a TABLE publication object, also as a continuation of a TABLE list (gram.y, PublicationObjSpec and preprocess_pubobj_list, 'invalid table name'; 42601).
